explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1198 with Smith's negative answer. It is not true that every 2-colouring of ℕ admits a strictly increasing positive sequence for which all expressions Σ_j ∏_{i∈S_j} a_i get the same colour, over k ≥ 1 pairwise disjoint nonempty index sets, excluding the trivial single-element expressions. The exclusion clause correctly removes exactly the k = 1, |S_1| = 1 case.
